Shops
McDuck's Department Store
Once you've entered the park and arrived at Mediterranean Harbor, head left to reach this grand store.
Your number one spot for Duffy and Friends merchandise.
Galleria Disney
Find this shop immediately to the left past the DisneySea AquaSphere once you enter the park.
A convenient place for shopping after entering or before leaving the park.
Aunt Peg's Village Store
A store located in Cape Cod, the fishing village at American Waterfront.
Enjoy shopping in this relaxed environment.
